description: This file defines FastAPI routes for admin functionalities in the Travel Planner Pro project, including user management and dashboard statistics.

classes.name: UserResponse
classes.description: Schema for user data returned via API.

classes.name: AdminAction
classes.description: Enumeration of admin actions for logging.

methods.name: UserResponse _user_to_response(user: User)
methods.description: Converts a User ORM object to a UserResponse schema.

methods.name: list_users( admin: User = Depends(require_admin), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Returns a list of all users (admin only).

methods.name: update_user_role( user_id: str, payload: UpdateUserRoleRequest, admin: User = Depends(require_admin), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Updates a user's role and logs the action.

methods.name: delete_user( user_id: str, admin: User = Depends(require_admin), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Deletes a user account with checks to prevent self-deletion, logs the action.

methods.name: get_admin_stats( admin: User = Depends(require_admin), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Returns aggregated statistics for the admin dashboard.
